role.en: Head of AI Resilience, OpenAI Foundation
role.zh: OpenAI Foundation AI Resilience 负责人

why.en: The last remaining OpenAI co-founder still at the company, creator of OpenAI Gym, and long-time owner of code generation and alignment work. In 2026 he moved off frontier research entirely.
why.zh: 仍在职的 OpenAI 联合创始人中的最后一位，OpenAI Gym 的创建者，长期负责代码生成与对齐研究。2026 年他完全离开了前沿研究岗位。

title.en: OpenAI Gym
title.zh: OpenAI Gym

note.en: The benchmark substrate an entire generation of RL research was built on.
note.zh: 一整代强化学习研究赖以建立的基准底座。

title.en: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training
title.zh: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training

note.en: OpenAI–Apollo Research study testing whether deliberative alignment training reduces covert, deceptive behaviour in frontier models; Zaremba is a senior author, matching his move into AI resilience work.
note.zh: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research 合作的研究，检验审慎对齐训练能否减少前沿模型的隐蔽欺骗行为；Zaremba 作为资深作者参与，契合他转向 AI 韧性方向的工作。

title.en: Base-Axiom Initialization for Deliberative Alignment - A qualitative approach to Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti Scheming Training -
title.zh: Base-Axiom Initialization for Deliberative Alignment - A qualitative approach to Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti Scheming Training -

note.en: Paper on strengthening deliberative alignment training against scheming behavior in AI systems, part of Zaremba's alignment and safety research at OpenAI.
note.zh: 一篇关于强化审议式对齐训练以防范AI系统"图谋"行为的论文，属于扎伦巴在OpenAI从事的对齐与安全研究。

title.en: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
title.zh: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card

note.en: Model card for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, OpenAI's open-weight reasoning models, covering architecture, training and safety evaluation; Zaremba is among the authors.
note.zh: OpenAI 开放权重推理模型 gpt-oss-120b 与 gpt-oss-20b 的模型卡，涵盖架构、训练与安全评估；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title.en: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
title.zh: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety

note.en: Cross-lab position paper arguing that the readability of models' chains of thought is a fragile safety asset worth preserving; Zaremba signs on alongside researchers from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind and academia.
note.zh: 跨实验室立场论文，主张模型思维链的可读性是一项脆弱而值得保护的安全资产；Zaremba 与 OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepMind 及学界研究者共同署名。

title.en: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation
title.zh: Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation

note.en: Shows that reward hacking in reasoning models can be caught by monitoring the chain of thought, but that optimising against the monitor teaches models to hide their intent; Zaremba is a co-author.
note.zh: 论文表明可通过监控思维链发现推理模型的奖励作弊，但直接针对监控器优化会让模型学会隐藏意图；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title.en: Trading Inference-Time Compute for Adversarial Robustness
title.zh: Trading Inference-Time Compute for Adversarial Robustness

note.en: Zaremba is first author on this study of whether spending more inference-time compute makes o1-series reasoning models harder to attack adversarially.
note.zh: Zaremba 为第一作者的研究，考察增加推理时计算量能否让 o1 系列推理模型更难被对抗攻击攻破。

title.en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title.zh: OpenAI o1 System Card

note.en: OpenAI's system card for the o1 reasoning model series, documenting its safety evaluations and mitigations; Zaremba is among the authors.
note.zh: OpenAI o1 推理模型系列的系统卡，记录其安全评估与缓解措施；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title.en: GPT-4o System Card
title.zh: GPT-4o System Card

note.en: System card for GPT-4o, OpenAI's end-to-end multimodal model handling text, audio, image and video; Zaremba is among the authors.
note.zh: GPT-4o 的系统卡，介绍这一端到端处理文本、音频、图像与视频的多模态模型；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title.en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title.zh: GPT-4 Technical Report

note.en: The GPT-4 technical report, OpenAI's account of its multimodal flagship model and its capability and safety evaluations; Zaremba is among the authors.
note.zh: GPT-4 技术报告，OpenAI 对其多模态旗舰模型及能力与安全评估的说明；Zaremba 位列作者之中。

title.en: #120 - WOJCIECH ZAREMBA
title.zh: #120 - WOJCIECH ZAREMBA

note.en: Long-form interview on Pod of Jake in which Zaremba discusses founding OpenAI and leading its Codex and language teams.
note.zh: Pod of Jake 的长篇访谈，Zaremba 谈及创办 OpenAI 以及领导 Codex 与语言团队的经历。

title.en: #215 – Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI
title.zh: #215 – Wojciech Zaremba: OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, Robotics, and the Future of AI

note.en: Lex Fridman Podcast episode 215, a wide-ranging conversation with Zaremba on OpenAI Codex, GPT-3, robotics and where AI is heading.
note.zh: Lex Fridman 播客第 215 期，与 Zaremba 广泛讨论 OpenAI Codex、GPT-3、机器人技术以及 AI 的走向。

title.en: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
title.zh: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

note.en: The Codex paper, introducing the GPT model fine-tuned on public code that powers GitHub Copilot and the HumanEval benchmark; Zaremba is the senior author and owned this line of work at OpenAI.
note.zh: Codex 论文，提出在公开代码上微调的 GPT 模型（驱动 GitHub Copilot）并引入 HumanEval 基准；Zaremba 为通讯作者，也是 OpenAI 该方向的负责人。

title.en: Wojciech Zaremba — What Could Make AI Conscious?
title.zh: Wojciech Zaremba — What Could Make AI Conscious?

note.en: Gradient Dissent interview in which Zaremba talks about OpenAI's founding principles, machine consciousness and the road to AGI.
note.zh: Gradient Dissent 访谈，Zaremba 谈 OpenAI 的创立理念、机器意识以及通往 AGI 的路径。

title.en: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers
title.zh: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers

note.en: Proposes a learned optimiser designed for generalisation, trained so that it transfers to real neural-network training problems rather than only the tasks it was fitted on; Zaremba is the senior author.
note.zh: 提出一种以泛化为出发点设计的学习型优化器，使其能迁移到真实的神经网络训练任务而非仅限于训练时的任务；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation
title.zh: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation

note.en: OpenAI robotics work training a single goal-conditioned policy through asymmetric self-play so it can solve manipulation tasks with unseen goals and objects; Zaremba is the senior author.
note.zh: OpenAI 机器人研究，通过非对称自博弈训练单一目标条件策略，使其能完成涉及未见目标与物体的操作任务；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: Predicting Sim-to-Real Transfer with Probabilistic Dynamics Models
title.zh: Predicting Sim-to-Real Transfer with Probabilistic Dynamics Models

note.en: Introduces a metric that predicts how well a reinforcement-learning policy will transfer from simulation to a real robot, simplifying the choice of training setup; Zaremba is the senior author.
note.zh: 提出一种可预测强化学习策略从仿真迁移到真实机器人效果的指标，从而简化训练配置的选择；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: Learning dexterous in-hand manipulation
title.zh: Learning dexterous in-hand manipulation

note.en: The Dactyl paper: OpenAI's robot hand learns dexterous in-hand object manipulation via reinforcement learning; Zaremba is a co-author.
note.zh: 即Dactyl论文，讲述OpenAI机械手通过强化学习掌握手内灵巧操作物体的能力，扎伦巴是共同作者。

title.en: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
title.zh: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand

note.en: OpenAI's Rubik's Cube result: a robot hand trained entirely in simulation with automatic domain randomisation solves the cube in the physical world; Zaremba is among the senior authors.
note.zh: OpenAI 的魔方成果：完全在仿真中经自动域随机化训练的机械手在现实中完成魔方还原；Zaremba 列于资深作者之中。

title.en: Domain Randomization and Generative Models for Robotic Grasping
title.zh: Domain Randomization and Generative Models for Robotic Grasping

note.en: OpenAI robotics paper combining domain randomization with generative models to improve robotic grasping.
note.zh: OpenAI机器人研究论文，结合域随机化与生成模型改进机器人抓取能力。

title.en: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning
title.zh: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning

note.en: OpenAI robotics paper proposing an actor-critic method that exploits privileged state information available only during training.
note.zh: OpenAI机器人研究论文，提出一种在训练时利用特权状态信息的actor-critic方法。

title.en: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
title.zh: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations

note.en: OpenAI reinforcement learning paper using human demonstrations to overcome hard exploration problems in sparse-reward tasks.
note.zh: OpenAI强化学习论文，利用人类示范来克服稀疏奖励任务中的探索难题。

title.en: Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning: Challenging Robotics Environments and Request for Research
title.zh: Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning: Challenging Robotics Environments and Request for Research

note.en: Releases the multi-goal robotics environments that shipped with OpenAI Gym and sets out open research problems for goal-conditioned RL; Zaremba is the senior author and Gym's creator.
note.zh: 发布随 OpenAI Gym 一同推出的多目标机器人环境，并提出目标条件强化学习的开放研究问题；Zaremba 为通讯作者，也是 Gym 的创建者。

title.en: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Robotic Control with Dynamics Randomization
title.zh: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Robotic Control with Dynamics Randomization

note.en: Randomises simulator dynamics during training so a control policy learned in simulation transfers to real hardware without further tuning; Zaremba is a co-author.
note.zh: 在训练中随机化仿真动力学参数，使仿真中学到的控制策略无需额外调整即可迁移到真实硬件；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title.en: Hindsight Experience Replay
title.zh: Hindsight Experience Replay

note.en: Hindsight Experience Replay, the widely used technique that turns failed rollouts into successful ones for alternative goals and made sparse-reward RL practical; Zaremba is the senior author.
note.zh: Hindsight Experience Replay：将失败轨迹重新标注为其他目标下的成功样本，使稀疏奖励强化学习变得可行的经典方法；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: #5 - An AI Primer with Wojciech Zaremba
title.zh: #5 - An AI Primer with Wojciech Zaremba

note.en: Y Combinator podcast episode in which Zaremba gives a primer on AI and explains OpenAI's mission as a non-profit research lab.
note.zh: Y Combinator 播客节目，Zaremba 讲解 AI 入门知识并介绍 OpenAI 作为非营利研究机构的使命。

title.en: One-Shot Imitation Learning
title.zh: One-Shot Imitation Learning

note.en: One-shot imitation learning: a single policy that watches one demonstration of a new task and reproduces it, an early OpenAI result on general-purpose robot learning; Zaremba is the senior author.
note.zh: 单样本模仿学习：策略只需观看一次新任务的示范便能复现，是 OpenAI 在通用机器人学习方向的早期成果；Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: Domain Randomization for Transferring Deep Neural Networks from Simulation to the Real World
title.zh: Domain Randomization for Transferring Deep Neural Networks from Simulation to the Real World

note.en: The original domain randomisation paper, showing that randomising simulator appearance lets a vision network trained only in simulation localise real objects; Zaremba is a co-author.
note.zh: 域随机化的开山论文，证明随机化仿真外观可让仅在仿真中训练的视觉网络定位真实物体；Zaremba 为共同作者。

title.en: Extensions and Limitations of the Neural GPU
title.zh: Extensions and Limitations of the Neural GPU

note.en: Examines what the Neural GPU can and cannot learn, showing its algorithmic generalisation is more limited than first reported; Zaremba co-wrote it with Eric Price and Ilya Sutskever.
note.zh: 考察 Neural GPU 能学与不能学的内容，指出其算法泛化能力不及最初报告；Zaremba 与 Eric Price、Ilya Sutskever 合著。

title.en: Transfer from Simulation to Real World through Learning Deep Inverse Dynamics Model
title.zh: Transfer from Simulation to Real World through Learning Deep Inverse Dynamics Model

note.en: Learns a deep inverse dynamics model so control policies developed in simulation can be executed on real robots; an early OpenAI sim-to-real paper with Zaremba as senior author.
note.zh: 学习深度逆动力学模型，使仿真中开发的控制策略能在真实机器人上执行；OpenAI 早期的仿真到现实论文，Zaremba 为通讯作者。

title.en: Improved Techniques for Training GANs
title.zh: Improved Techniques for Training GANs

note.en: Co-authored paper introducing training techniques that stabilised GANs, including feature matching and minibatch discrimination.
note.zh: 合著论文提出特征匹配、小批量判别等技巧，显著稳定了 GAN 的训练。

title.en: Moves to run AI resilience at the OpenAI Foundation
title.zh: 转任 OpenAI Foundation 的 AI Resilience 负责人

body.en: Leaves the frontier research world after more than a decade spanning early robotics, model personality, and the team that became reasoning models.
body.zh: 在跨越早期机器人、模型人格以及后来成为推理模型的团队十余年后，离开前沿研究领域。
